evidence.NO_ROOT_ESCAPE: PhysicalResolver.Resolve uses assertWithinRoot; Reverse rejects paths outside all known roots
evidence.NO_PATH_TRAVERSAL: normalizeAndValidatePath rejects raw/encoded '..' segments, backslash, control chars, null bytes, and applies path.Clean + residual traversal check
evidence.NO_SECRET_IN_URI: Parse rejects userinfo, port, fragment, query — secret-bearing URL components
evidence.NO_PERMISSION_AUTHORITY_IN_RESOURCEURI: resourceuri contains no PermissionRegistry / PermissionStore / AccessGrant DB
evidence.NO_DIRECT_AGENT_PROVIDER_BYPASS: ResourceURI is not an Agent Tool execution surface; access chain remains Agent -> Tool -> ExecutionPipeline -> Permission -> Workspace/File Provider -> ResourceURI
evidence.NO_SECOND_RESOURCE_SCHEME: amitia is the only official scheme; ResourceURI does not recognize file://, sftp://, workspace://, etc. as internal logical URIs
